name: Closing Checklist — Disposition
description: Paperwork required before a property can be sold or transferred out of District ownership.

items.label: Title reviewed for restrictions
items.description: Confirm no deed restriction, grant condition or reversionary interest prevents disposal.

items.label: Appraisal completed
items.description: Current appraisal establishing fair market value.

items.label: Grant and funding obligations cleared
items.description: Confirm whether any acquisition funding requires repayment or agency consent.

items.label: Environmental review completed
items.description: Disclose known conditions to the buyer or receiving agency.

items.label: Survey current and adequate
items.description: Confirm the existing survey is sufficient, or order an update.

items.label: Public notice published
items.description: Publish notice of the proposed disposition as required.

items.label: Board approval recorded
items.description: Board approval of the disposition, with the recommendation memorandum attached.

items.label: Sale or transfer agreement executed
items.description: Signed by the receiving party and the District's authorised signatory.

items.label: Closing completed
items.description: Funds received or transfer effected; deed delivered and recorded.

items.label: Property records updated
items.description: Parcel marked disposed in LAMS and removed from active management schedules.
